title: Web Developer
jd: Example Folio Books is looking for a web developer to build pages and services for our online bookstore. You will design REST endpoints that return JSON over HTTP. You will add OAuth sign-in for readers and configure CORS for the storefront. Comfort writing SQL queries against the catalogue is expected.

title: API Engineer
jd:
Example Folio Books needs an engineer for its partner interfaces.

What you'll do
- Keep every partner integration healthy

Requirements
- 3+ years of experience building partner integrations
- REST endpoints documented with OpenAPI
- OAuth for partner sign-in
- Terraform for the partner sandbox

Nice to have
- Rate limiting, so that no partner can overload the catalogue

title: Frontend Engineer
jd: Build the storefront that readers use every day. You will handle CORS and CSRF protection, tune HTTP caching for fast pages, and keep live stock counts fresh over websockets.

title: Platform Engineer
jd: Run the platform behind the bookstore. You will package services with Docker, manage load balancing and the CDN, and improve observability across services.

title: Senior Staff Engineer
jd: Lead the design of a GraphQL gateway and own TLS policy for every service.

title: Support Engineer
jd: Help partners diagnose integration problems: read HTTP traces, check DNS records, and debug TLS handshakes.

title: Integration Engineer
jd: Connect Example Folio Books to publisher systems through REST interfaces secured with OAuth and TLS.
